description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1926/18 of 03.08.2015 , Cad. Map No. 320241, Udunuwara D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content deals exclusively with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing corrections to village names and Grama Niladhari Division designations for various parcels of land in Kandy District. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land title settlement matters, making it a clear example of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title amendments.
